metadata.title: Where to Use Seedance: Platforms, Providers & Access
metadata.description: Find where to use Seedance 2.0 and 2.5 across official products, BytePlus ModelArk, and third-party platforms, with an access and pricing checklist.

hero.title: Seedance Platforms & Providers
hero.description: A practical guide to Dreamina Seedance 2.0, Higgsfield Seedance 2.0, CapCut Seedance 2.0, Seedance Higgsfield, BytePlus, OpenRouter, and other Seedance platform searches. Verify the exact model and terms before you generate.
hero.tip: A platform may expose only one Seedance version or tier. Confirm current model labels, regions, output limits, billing, and commercial terms on the platform itself.

introduce.title: Map the platform to the task
introduce.description: Seedance access is not a single website. Consumers, developers, and teams may use different products, providers, APIs, or regional experiences.

items.title: Consumer products
items.description: Official rollout information may mention Jimeng AI, Doubao Pro, and other ByteDance surfaces. Account and region eligibility still matters.

items.title: Developer APIs
items.description: BytePlus ModelArk provides versioned documentation, model IDs, request schemas, and billing information for supported markets.

items.title: Third-party providers
items.description: Higgsfield, CapCut, Artlist, fal, OpenRouter, and other platforms may list Seedance at different times and under different limits.

items.title: Seadance Video
items.description: This site offers a browser workflow based on the currently connected Seedance 2.0 model; it is not the model owner or a universal provider directory.

benefits.title: Platform questions worth answering
benefits.description: Use these checks for a fair comparison instead of choosing a platform from a search snippet alone.

items.title: Which version is offered?
items.description: Check whether the platform has Seedance 2.0, 2.0 Fast, Mini, 2.5, or a provider-specific model ID.

items.title: Which inputs work?
items.description: Confirm text, first frame, first/last frame, image references, video references, audio, and editing support.

items.title: What does the output include?
items.description: Review duration, resolution, aspect ratio, audio, watermark, queue, and retention behavior.

items.title: What does the plan allow?
items.description: Read credits, trial, unlimited, concurrency, commercial use, source rights, and moderation rules.

features.title: Seedance platform research template
features.description: Capture these six fields when you compare Dreamina Seedance 2.0, Higgsfield Seedance, BytePlus, or another provider.

items.title: Provider and region
items.description: Record the product URL, account region, and date checked.

items.title: Exact model
items.description: Copy the full model name or ID shown in the current interface or API docs.

items.title: Supported workflow
items.description: Note whether the task is text-to-video, image-to-video, reference-to-video, or editing.

items.title: Limits
items.description: Record duration, reference count, file size, resolution, concurrency, and queue conditions.

items.title: Billing
items.description: Write down the plan, credit formula, price unit, and failed-task policy.

items.title: Rights and support
items.description: Confirm commercial terms, moderation process, export format, and support channel.

faq.title: Seedance Platforms FAQ
faq.description: Clear answers for the most common Seedance searches and workflows.

items.question: Where can I use Seedance 2.0?
items.answer: Access depends on the provider and region. This site currently exposes Seedance 2.0 through its browser generator, while official and third-party platforms may provide other surfaces.

items.question: Where can I use Seedance 2.5?
items.answer: Official materials identify consumer and BytePlus ModelArk access in supported markets. Check the current product page for eligibility, exact model, and limits.

items.question: Is Seedance on Dreamina or Higgsfield?
items.answer: The names appear in search and provider discussions, but the available version and plan can change. Verify the current model selector rather than relying on an old review.

items.question: Can OpenRouter or fal provide Seedance?
items.answer: Provider catalogs change. Check the current model listing, API schema, price, region, and rights before integrating or paying.

items.question: Is Seadance Video an official ByteDance site?
items.answer: No. Seadance Video is an independent third-party platform. ByteDance Seed is the model owner; provider access and site features are separate questions.

cta.title: Choose a verified access surface
cta.description: Record the model, region, limits, price, and terms before you commit credits or connect a production pipeline.
